mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, id AS modelId, code, display_name AS displayName, model_family AS modelFamily FROM ai_public_model WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT r.tenant_id AS tenantId, r.id AS resourceId, r.provider_id AS providerId, r.upstream_connection_id AS connectionId, r.credential_id AS credentialId, r.resource_type AS resourceType, r.admin_status AS adminStatus, p.provider_kind AS providerKind, c.protocol_type AS protocolType, c.base_url AS baseUrl, cred.credential_type AS credentialType, cred.secret_reference AS secretReference, cred.encrypted_secret AS encryptedSecret, cred.nonce AS nonce FROM ai_execution_resource r INNER JOIN ai_provider p ON p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND p.id = r.provider_id INNER JOIN ai_upstream_connection c ON c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND c.id = r.upstream_connection_id INNER JOIN ai_credential cred ON cred.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND cred.id = r.credential_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.admin_status IN ('ENABLED', 'DRAINING') AND p.status = 'ENABLED' AND c.status = 'ENABLED' AND cred.admin_status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY r.id ASC
